# The npx ACP adapters the live handshake test runs, pinned (ov-414).
#
# One package@version per line; `#` starts a comment. The built-in presets in
# crates/core/src/activity.rs launch these with `npx -y <package>`, which takes
# whatever npm calls newest, so the test `every_built_in_backend_completes_a_
# handshake` runs these versions instead and a bad publish cannot turn main red.
# The test also fails when a built-in npx adapter has no line here, or a line
# names a package no preset launches.
#
# agent-clis-latest.yml sets FARCOOLER_ACP_LATEST=1 and runs the same test on
# the newest versions once a day, and opens an issue when that fails. The
# product itself stays unpinned on purpose: users should get an adapter fix
# the day it ships, and a pin would strand them on a stale one.
#
# To move a pin: wait for the scheduled run to go green on the new version (or
# run it by hand), then change the line here.
@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@0.86.0
@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@2.1.1
cursor-agent-acp@0.1.1
